paths.reason: Register the already-existing, byte-verified GATE23 independent external reinspection report as a declared EXTERNAL_REINSPECTION_REPORT authority so resolveAuthority can classify it. The ledger event at ordinal 99 cites the report by its repository path, which no declaration matched, so the authority resolved as CANONICAL_EVIDENCE and COMPLETE_CONFIRMED_WITHOUT_INDEPENDENT_REINSPECTION was raised against a confirmation that is in fact valid. No new evidence is introduced and no verdict rule is changed; the existing STANDARD_EXTERNAL_REINSPECTION_REPORT shape check applies unmodified.
Single-use LOCAL_EXPLICIT_AUTHORITY bound to the exact post-GATE23-closure repository pre-state; predecessor maintenance authorities are single-use and already consumed and are not reused.
